name: Speaking The Truth In Love
overview: Scripture calls believers to consistently speak truth to one another, grounded in the reality that God's word is truth and Jesus Himself is the embodiment of truth and life. Zechariah 8:16 commands speaking truth to neighbors and upholding just judgment, while Ephesians 4:25 and 4:15 emphasize putting away falsehood and speaking truth in love to foster unity and spiritual maturity in Christ. This truth is not merely factual accuracy but a sanctifying power that leads to freedom and growth in the body of Christ.
